review_description: They quoted a bigger battery capacity matched to the inverter, which seemed like a good idea, in that they were both Goodwe. It was a difficult decision because one of the quotes was from a business in my town, which may have been handy down the track. I am now waiting for the inspector to come and switch the panels on and for the battery to turn up. I see that the next part of this review is based on my experience with this system, but as it is not functioning yet, that's not really possible. I only hope I get the same experience with this set-up as I have enjoyed with my original system. I have absolutely no gripes with Solar1 so far. They have been great in all aspects of the installation, although I haven't been up on the roof to check out the workmanship up there. They did leave a lot of brick dust from the drilling of holes for mounting of the equipment on the wall on the house, but that swept up quickly after they had left.Sorry, but I seem to have covered a lot of this section already. The quoting was very helpful, although I am looking forward to talking through the control process of the gear again when it is all finally installed and ready for commission and operation. The actual job on the roof was very organised and professional, all involved seemed to know what they were about and experienced.

A Solar 1 Electrical salesperson contacted me within a couple of hours of my requesting quotes from Solar Quotes. After a discussion around my exact requirements, he sent me a detailed quote with two options regarding battery size. After due consideration I accepted the quote for twelve (440W) additional solar panels to complement my existing thirteen (260W) panels installed about ten years ago and a 10 kWh battery. Cathy, the office administrator, explained the process going forward and helped me with the paperwork required to apply for the government subsidies.The actual installation happened over two days. The installation team were friendly and courteous and took all tbeir rubbish with them when they left.. The electrician gave me a detailed run-through of how the system was set up and how to use the accompanying ap.The independent electrical inspector who checked the system a week later commented to me that the installation was of a very high standard.

Solar1 was great to work with. They came onsite to check everything out, worked with me so l understood everything, and then installed it quickly. Just waiting for it to be ticked off and l can start saving money.I'm on an embedded system so didn't qualify for most of the grants unfortunately.Peter and his team were great. I would definitely recommend them.

Excellent service, highly recommend these guys! I emailed the team 3 weeks ago and our solar are already installed, checked and ready to go!  Christopher offered the best deal we could find and signing was a very easy process online. Cathy in admin was always prompt to answer our questions, and Thomas and the guys who installed very efficient and professional. The inspector who checked the install said it was very well done and very neat job. Thank you Solar 1 Electrical!

Our recent Solar/Battery installation by Solar1 was exceptionally carried out and commissioned. The Team arrived on time and were pleasant courteous and efficient. Having been a Sparkie and Project Manager I was pleased to see their adherence to OHS and the relevant electrical and Solar regulations. The Team impressed me greatly quickly setting up guard rails and ensuring their own safety and mine as a property owner. The guy who arrived to commission the installation was fantastic and extremely knowledgeable in fitting and testing the batteries and Inverter. We made a few changes during the quoting stage and the office staff were exceptionally patient and professional.I would strongly recommend Solar1 and would be happy to provide that recommendation in person.
Quoting process went very well, had no problems. Installation was done very well and tidy.
Happy with service and installation techs were polite and helpfull

Frankly without Leah at Solar 1 Electrical I would still be floundering around in the solar space. I'd tried a couple of times with other companies who were keen to sell me something and then they'd back off when they realised it wasn't going to be a quick install at my property, (without bothering to explain why). This is where Leah stood out, she listened and was prompt in getting back to me with a couple of workable options and quotes. Honestly she is the only consultant that took the time to go through the quotes with me, paitently answering my questions and guiding me through the rebate processes. Nothing was too much trouble, no question was silly and Cathy and the rest of the team at Solar 1 made the installation smooth sailing. I couldn't be happier with my choice, thanks Solar 1!

Solar1 Electrical was great all throughout the process. Leah came to my property and talked me through the solar system, what she thought would be best and answered all my questions. Very informative.Cathy kept in contact throughout payment and scheduling for the job and was open to further questions on the government rebate, and the install was done smoothly by Shane on the day in very hot weather!There were some initial problems getting the solar export meter configuration sorted due to the new backstop regulations, but this was looked into and resolved quickly. Everything is working as expected from here, really happy with how it all went.

Chose Solar 1 Electrical as Leah made it very smooth, explained everything, didn't put other companies down and helped me understand what to look out for and how to gain best benefits from my system. Really honest and upfront company from sales to installers. The install team, were absolute troopers, did not stop working in the heat, smashed it out. all lovely guys very professional.Highly recommend and loved keeping it local.

Each of the people that had anything with this installation from the receptionist, sales, installers were excellent.one of sales team came to our home to help work it out and give a quote . the installers had the system installed in one day  and it was connected to the grid two days later

The rep came to the house, listened to what I wanted from a solar system, suggested two systems that could meet my requirements and suggested one system that took notice of my previous bills and supplied the best system for my property.Always available to answer questionsInstallation was smooth and on time and the property was left neat and tidy.Great company to deal with.
Quote was easy and conciseinstall quick, customer service good

Professional service, tradesmen were very professional in both the work they performed and their approach.We found them very accommodating, and they answered any and all questions without any hesitation.A hassle free installation.
Great customer service, very helpful and knowledgeable throughout the process and the team did a fantastic job with the installation

The best solar company I have worked with excellent service from start to finish. The office staff explained all the processes and took extra time to explain everything the installation staff were fantastic it’s the little things like protecting the guttering as to not scratch it making sure everything was clean and neat and level cleaned up everything afterwards. I really can’t praise this company enough I got 8 quotes before deciding on Solar 1 and I’m so glad with my choice of installers THANK YOU SO MUCH SOLAR 1

Solar1 was the only company that came and saw my property and discussed with me what I needed. Every other installer just wanted me to send photos and sent a quote. I needed panels placed differently as my next door block may have a multiple story building placed on - thus blocking sunlight. I also needed solar panels from my gas water heater removed and an electrical water heater put it - which Solar 1 assisted me with. I have heard others say they got "remote" quotes but then the installer charged them for things they hadn't quoted for - because they had not seen the place (only standard photos) or asked the right questions from the purchaser. My advice is if the installer can't get and see you - don't use them. Solar 1 was the only installer out of a number I contacted that cared enough to call out to the property before making the quote for the work.

Communication was excellent from the first call through to installation. The installers were polite and stayed on task. We had some associated electrical works done at the same time and we are happy with the results.
Sales and quoting was great ,installation was really good. Everything went well and we are very happy how it all went.
From sales, quoting, installation, staff politeness, customer service was great. Very tidy work.
Friendly knowledgeable sales team that actually did an onsite inspection, friendly and professional installation team that did a high quality install.

Knowledgeable sales person who actually did attend the property. Good communication during the quotation and rebate application process.The installers were friendly, punctual and did a neat job. they also explained what i needed to know about the system.We are still going through the process of inspection and grid connection.
The whole team has been fantastic, from Leah and Kathy to the installation people.  They were all extremely friendly and knowledgeable, I wouldn’t hesitate to recommend them to anyone!

The sales process was not overwhelming. It was concise and easy to understand. This helped to make an informed decision.The installation happened on time. Customer service was good, and the installers got on with the job. They left no rubbish behind.There was a briefing at the end to demonstrate how the system operated and what the next steps would be.
Leah is amazing, so knowledgeable and helpful. Every step was professional and an enjoyable experience.
The whole process with Solar 1 Electrical has been very easy and if we were ever stuck at any part of the process there was always someone willing to help out straight away.

From the beginning l was impressed with the team at Solar 1.  Customer service was fantastic; they responded quickly to all my questions.When the team came out to install the solar l was again impressed with the cleanliness, courtesy and professionalism from them all.  I would recommend them to everyone wanting solar.

Quote was efficient and I was able to discuss specific needs.Installation was carried out over 2 days. Prompt arrival, quality wiring and connections. Care taken whilst on roof. All rubbish removed.Follow up on grid connection and setup of portals for battery and inverters was easy.
Cannot fault this installer in any way,great communications very easy to deal with through the whole prosses

The Solar 1 Electrical team were timely, efficient, careful and a most professional team. Their knowledge from Chritopher in sales to Thomas, Dylan, Simon and Zoey and co as electrician's in solar panels, inverters and batteries was exceptional. Thank you so much for our new solar system. Cath and Sandy (David). Hepburn Springs Victoria

We had a 1.7 Kw. system which was installed 14 years ago at the same time of year, Christmas Time, which as we all know is not the best time to have work done on the house. We had a 10.375 Kw. array with an 8,5 Kw. inverter installed, with the intention of sometime in the future adding battery storage, (to costly still in Vic) to help handle the excess electricity generated. At the moment, when generating 8.5Kw. we add up to 5Kw. to the grid, the max that Powercor will accept to the grid from any one system.The whole process was very smooth and timely, from the quote through to the inspection. The installation crew was polite, punctual and tidy. The system has only recently been installed so to be able to evaluate its value for money or Quality, only time will tell. Solar 1 Electrical help with all aspects of the process not just the supply and installation of the new solar hardware, removal of the old system as well. Solar 1 Electrical help with all the paperwork for the different authorities involved as well.

The quoting process to get to the installation was easy and informative, the guys made it very understandable.The installation was very efficient - the installation guys were very tidy, punctual and lovely to deal with, they left the grounds tidier than when they got there. They organised the 'grid' for me and made sure I understood everythingThe lovely people in the office were very patient and understanding with me (as I had a lot of questions).In all - everything was an easy and a pleasurable experience
Really good service, everything well explained, helpful and friendly install team and great value!

Solar 1 is a very good competitive company. Workers were very efficient and helpful. This was my second property I have used the services of Solar1. Highly recommended. They were installing panels on my shed and a very old panel of laser light crumbled due to age. Was replaced cheerfully at Solar1's cost. I asked them to replace another sheet at same time at my cost and they were happy to do this, labor free. Very happy with result.

100% recommend Solar 1 Electrical! From Christopher in sales to Cathy in admin, to the team installing on the day, I can't recommend highly enough. It's clear that this is a professional and well run business with great proposals, documentation, excellent communication, clear processes and support all the way. Products used have great warranties and reviews, the price is right for a reputable company in Bendigo. Thanks team!
Excellent to deal with through the whole process from initial quote to installation. Even had it installed and operational 2 weeks ahead of schedule. Would definitely recommend

Solar 1 Electrical were easy to work with throughout the quoting and installation process, great at answering questions, no pressure, useful information, clearly very experienced in what they do, and they know their smooth processes really well.The day of the installation was just as good. A very fast and efficient team who communicated well (e.g. turning off power etc) and a very clean installation with minimal mess left behind (e.g. conduit off cuts left on the roof, wiring off cuts on the ground) and the system hardware installed as per the specification.We paid extra for a Fronius Smart Meter, and unfortunately the web interface wasn't working after the system was generating power.  Solar 1 could have been a bit more supportive in resolving the issues through taking ownership of the issue, and following it through to resolution, rather than leaving me feeling like I had to chase it up continually until the issues were resolved. A suggestion for me to use the Powercor MyEnergy app instead was a nice idea, but my preference was to have the facilities that I'd paid for working correctly.  The problems were resolved by a firmware update being performed, and missing components (energy meter & inverter) being added and configured under our system profile in Fronius SolarWeb.  It's not clear to me who resolved the issues (Fronius or Solar 1 Electrical), but the eventual resolution was appreciated.
The sales staff were courteous and knowledgeable, while the first contact was within a few days. The installers were on time, friendly and efficient. I defiantly recommend Solar1

Very happy with our solar installation from Solar one.Communication and information was great from the start, the installation team were excellent, quoted quickly and our system was installed and up and running quicker than promised.The electrical/solar inspector said that the job and system was installed perfectly and that he is always happy with this companies standard of work.

Solar 1 was so easy to deal with, they told me everything i needed to know. They helped me with various designs until I found what I wanted. After i decided on the system, they emailed me a list of documents needed to use for the rebates program and it couldnt've been smoother. The installation guys were really friendly and went above and beyond to make sure I was happy, and explained any details that came up onsite.
Sales and quoting process excellentInstillation very well completed and cleaned up afterwardsCustomer service and information provided  was great

From first inquiry to final installation, I was very impressed with Solar 1's knowledge and professional approach. The team was super responsive answering my questions and guiding me on different options over several months until I was ready to make a decision. Customer Service did wonderful job handling the rest, making sure I was well informed both pre and post installation. I initially spoke to a number of providers and in the end, I was very pleased to have chosen Solar 1.
They took care of everything and had good instructions on any thing needed to be done.

Solar 1 Electrical were fantastic to deal with throughout the whole process from our initial enquiry to installation and organising our grid connection. We were kept informed of our progress the whole way through. All staff that we interacted with were very friendly and professional.

All three quotes/businesses were really good. We decided to go with the local company as they identified a couple of issues at our property with a physical visit.  The installation went extremely well and connection to the grid completed.  We had to wait as the inverter we selected was not in stock.

The technicalities of solar power are beyond me, so I sought quotes both from the SolarQuotes website and 1 other provider. The Solar 1 people actually came to the property, as opposed to just working off Google Earth photos, and their quote for near interchangeable panels / inverter was competitive. I had several productive phone calls with their sales team, to clarify questions I had about the whole installation process. Once we decided to proceed, the necessary paperwork to satisfy power company and government requirements was forwarded, and easily completed, and the actual installation happened on the promised day.Obviously we are just beginning our solar "journey" but Solar 1 certainly made it a straightforward process.

We cancelled a contract with a previous solar company because they could not get an installer to our property.We visited Solar 1 electrical at their premises and were shown what we could get and the price.They came to our house to check location of the panels & batteries. Once the paperwork (solar rebate) was done they sent a team to the house and installed everything on the day.The then sent Powercor our info so the could reconfigure our meterWe are very happy with the result.
Local Business;Competitive Quote;Only average communication, at times;Great Installation crew.Final inspection still to be done, so grid connection success unknown.
Very professional, helpful, polite, tidy and punctual. Quote was comprehensive
Very friendly, arranged everything for us. Quick quoting, took longer to install than anticipated due to the rain.

The quote process, instigated by using the SolarQuotes website, was very good. Lots of questions answered and due to a few unknowns with a new house build, some specification changes during the process. All handled well by Chris from Sales. Our installation was put on hold for a few months at our request, but the Solar 1 Electrical team were very accommodating.Once the installation day came it was done by a very thorough and clearly very competent team, arriving on time and then working out the best layout to get the maximum amount of panels in the best place, same with the inverter placement. We were very happy with the way the install was approached and this team finished the install in a single day, working in clearly experienced teams. The system is preforming excellently so the layout decision process has been very justified. Well done Solar 1 Electrical
Sales staff were professional and respond to queries promptly. Leah/Kathy send updates throughout the whole process.  Quality of installation although took 2 days, is highly recommended.

Easy to understand process.Office staff friendly and communicativeInstallation crew installed in one day the battery and solar panels. Very helpful and a professional approach.My second buy from this company (moved house). That says it all

Solar1 were very professional and talked me through the process easily. Even filled out the rebate website for me. The installers were prompt and cheerful, coping with a difficult access without complaint. It's good to have the backup of their own team, if needed in the future.

Everything went extremely smoothly. Leah and the staff I dealt with, were professional and acted efficiently to get my solar up and running in a timely manner. They communicated continually about the installation process and kept me updated on where we were up to.I would 100% recommended Solar1 for your solar installation.
The solar 1 team were great to work with on the installation of our residential panels. From the sales team right through to the install, communication was thorough and timely.

From our initial contact with Leah at Solar1 we knew we had contacted the right solar provider.  Leah and Cathy supplied us with all the information we needed and answered all (including the dumb ones) questions we had regarding installation options and subsidies etc.  Once we had sorted everything from our end it was smooth sailing all the way, paperwork was easy to understand and we were talked through it all the way.  James arrived for the pre installation inspection and was very thorough, he explained everything in detail and we couldn’t have been happier with the service provided again.  On installation day the crew arrived and were very efficient and made minimum disruption to our day.  They cleaned up very thoroughly and explained the next steps in great detail before leaving site.  We received a follow up phone call from Leah explaining what the next process will be and we recommend the team at Solar1 ten fold.  Thanks team.Chris & Maxine

The installation was delayed due to global supply chain issues beyond their control. However, they were a very frustrating business to deal with. There was no communication from them when installation was delayed and it took several unanswered calls to get a response. Post installation it took weeks to sort out issues getting access to my data on solarweb. Having sent an email explaining the problem, leaving a voicemail and texting the installer I got a call from the office manager who knew nothing about the issue even though I had left the message and email with her.I definitely will not be recommending them to anyone.

I have recently purchased by own place and was wanting to get solar. I obtained 2 quotes from local Solar companies. Solar 1 Electrical was super quick at coming out and providing me with a quote, and they were the best value for money, comparing them to the second company for the same service. When it came to the installation it only took around 1-2 days for my system to be up and running and the guys who came out to install it were punctual and very friendly to deal with. I would highly be recommending Leah and the team to anyone, when looking at solar.

Solar1Electrical are an awesome team to deal with.Being new to Solar, Leah explained everything to me in a way that was very clear and easy to understand and steered me in what i can only describe as "The right direction". Even advising me not to do certain things as would have been a waste of money.The installers were a fun and professional bunch of guys, Although their mission to try and pat Mum's dog didn't go too well, Her dog is very grumpy around strangers.Would definitely deal with them again.Neil in Maryborough

The sales manager has  visited the property and given the quote which has addressed all the requirement  of our needs out of five different companies.The installation, communication and the administration of the solar1 company  are meeting all the professional standards.

The staff has been great. I upgraded my system from the original quote and staff has been responsive every step of the way. The installation went smoothly and even the inspector said that he’s inspected their work before and that Solar1 knows what they are doing. It’s also peace of mind because I know this company is not fly by night and they use components that are reliable with a good reputation. They were also responsive to my schedule when I said I needed to repair a leak in the roof before I could get them to install the system. I read the free book on Solarquotes and knew what to watch out for and Solar 1 ticked all the boxes. I dealt with Leah, Cathy and Andrew. First rate service.
Overall the service was greatAble to keep us informed with all details and process of installationHappy to recommend

We decided to add to our existing solar installation which is small & getting towards the end of its life, & went through Solar Quotes as we didn't know a great deal about who the better installers around Bendigo are.On a side note we found the Solar Quotes website fantastic - it really assisted us to make informed decisions about which way to go with installers, panel location, system size/type, etc.All three installers were great (prompt, knowledgeable & happy to help) & it was tough picking one. In the end we went with Solar 1 as they would do all of the work themselves (no subcontracting) & they had an emphasis on quality. They also happened to have the best price. All installers provided lots of different options/ideas.We have an unusual setup - existing solar, weird roof design, full switchboard, etc & we also wanted the new solar system to be hardwired (not Wi-Fi). Solar 1 dealt with all of this well.The only issues we encountered (all minor) were:* A few mix-ups with export limiting being incorrectly nominated on some of our paperwork (sorted pretty quickly though).* The panels were installed too close to the edge of the roof making it unsafe to walk around that side of the panels now. Our instructions must have been misunderstood.* We had to cut off some of the excess aluminium brackets on the roof to reduce future tripping hazards.* We rerouted the Ethernet cable under the house to get it out of harm's way.* We had to reinstall some insulation & remove some scrap from inside the roof.A lot of people probably don't get up their roofs, inside their roofs or under their houses, but we need to from time to time.The rest of the job was excellent & Solar 1 even asked us for our feedback at the end which we think proves that they care about the quality of their work & reputation.

The sales and quoting process was seamless.The installation was done in a day with all staff on site courteous, polite and left the site like they hadn't been there, accept for the new 11kW solar system.Solar 1 Electrical organised the inspection and the grid connection so no stress on our behalf.
Very friendly, accommodating and professional. Even with many interruptions due to COVID we still received our system install in a timely manner.

When I was getting quotes Solar 1 were more than happy to answer all my questions. They explained things well and were patient with me. The customer service was fantastic, the whole team were nice and friendly. I’m confident with the panels and inverter that we chose based off their recommendations and our research. Communication was great, their estimation of timeframe was correct and the installation day went smoothly. A big thank you to the Solar 1 team!
Not yet done Covid regulations delayed installation quote was what I stipulated no Chinese components

Couldn't have been happier with the service and professionalism all round. The office team (Cathy, Leah & Peter) kept me constantly in the loop with progress and guided us through the process, the installers (Simon and team) were prompt, gave me all the info needed, let me know when they were arriving and talked me through different options available. Super super happy with progress and now enjoying soaking up the solar rays!
Our system is now complete in a very short time

Very satisfied with Solar 1 Electrical. The quoting was straightforward with Leah competently managing all aspects. We were a bit different in that I knew exactly  what I wanted in terms of inverters (Enphase microinverters) since I had already had a similar system installed on another property. Solar 1 kept us fully informed of progress at all stages of the exercise. The crew that undertook the physical install were at all times courteous and good humoured.There was a bit of a hiccup in that our roof is colorbond and at this time of the year it has moisture on it from either rain or dew or both for most of the day which makes it very slippery; this did increase the time taken a little.Solar 1 organised the required statutory inspections and final activation of the system in a timely manner.

From the sales person to the install and final inspection all went smoothly. I ended up getting about 8 quotes, now they were not the cheapest of them all but that can be put down to differing parts be it panels and inverters. The thing that attracted me the most was they don't use contractors. Which i feel is probably the biggest downfall that and cheap inverter and panels. Im only a few days in after the inspection was done, surprisingly a lot sooner than expected. The system so far has performed well considering it is dead middle of winter with no sun out. Im sure will be great once the warmer months come along.
Solar 1 Electrical, from the sales process to the installation of the solar panel a very professional outfit that I would recommend to anyone.

We had Solar 1 Electrical recommended to us from family and friends. Leah at Solar 1 was awesome to deal with and knew the product and process very well which made the experience so easy. From start to finish Leah and the Solar 1 team were professional and great with communication.
Sales and quoting process was quick without fuss, although I wasn't present when installation occurred, my estate agent gave feedback from my tenant, that all went smoothly.

After looking at 4 different companies we decide to go with Solar 1 Electrical. We narrowed it down to the Fronius inverter and the Sun Power panels. Leah was the first person we dealt with and we received regular follow ups and progress information. Both Leah and Cathy were very helpful initially, during and after the installation. The installation was carried out without any issues and the crew on both days were polite, knowledgeable and went over each item in detail. The final deciding factor for us in the end was based on the fact that they use their own people and do not subcontract, its a local business and they provided a competitive price. We would not hesitate to recommend them  and we felt that we received a great service, good value for money for our Solar investment.

We did our research on panels and inverters and obtained 3 quotes. Solar1 Electrical provided the most comprehensive information and advice, they listened to what we wanted and gave us alternative suggestions and quotes. Leah was thorough and helpful and questions were answered promptly.  Installation was professional and the team were exceptional.  We are very happy with the service and advice and delighted that we chose Solar1 Electrical.
As above everything was on time and seamless. Could not be more pleased. Rate Solar1 very high.

Excellent service from sales enquire, assistance with regulations, first class installation team of friendly expert professionals,and great assistance with final setup to grid connection.A great solar connection team.Thanks to you all,Jan and Neil

I did not have any dramas apart from a small brake down in communications.I was expecting a call letting me know what day the next week my solar was to be installed, but got a call letting me know they were there to install the system.Apart from that everything was fine, the system was inspected the next day, and I think I received confirmation of my solar being registered the following week.The system seems to be producing a little more than expected. They even helped set up the online monitoring.I ended up buying a better quality system than planed due to it not costing all that much more than a cheaper system.

I was thrilled with the end to end customer service provided by Solar1. I had so many questions as we wanted to really utilize our system for summer afternoons. Paul was fantastic in making this happen along with the fieldies. They were professional and easy to talk to, and the only company to come out and look at the site while quoting. One of the main reasons we picked Solar1 (as well as the competitive price) was the excellent customer service and being a local business.

There is never a better time to have solar installed with Federal and State grants available with increasing energy prices. We found Solar 1 Electrical Pty Ltd. very helpful for us to achieve this, not only free quote by there sales representative but came to our home and suggested best options for alternate solar and prestige appearance. They where also prepared to negotiate. There financial administration also help with the Federal and State grants to a point were they did everything except, I only had to add a signature. They also organize grid connection with energy suppliers and final inspection.Installation was very neat and thorough and would have a rating in my opinion of 10.We are very pleased with our installation with Solar 1 Electrical. All we had to do was pay our account.I normally do not do this sort of review as I don't believe it is necessary, but in this case when good workmanship and customer relationship is hard to find; it is easy to comment on excellent result.Ian.

Very pleased with the hole process. The quote was quick and professional. The girls were nothing but helpful. Installation went well. The installers were nice guys, tidy workers (no mess left behind) and polite. Connection went well. Very pleased as we are in credit now. No bill to pay it's great.

The  whole deal was great from beginning to end. The sales team were extremely knowledgeable and answered all our queries in a very professional manner. The installation team were fast, efficient and polite. The handover was seamless and the follow up has been good . We are extremely happy with the whole exercise. I would recommend Solar 1 to anybody that is looking to get a solar system.

Of the three quotes, one was placing the panels on the neighbour's roof and I chose the less expensive of the others. I used Solar Quotes' information and checklists to scrutinise the offer, but found the salesperson defensive, making passive-aggressive "courtesy calls" to the point where I was wishing that I had worked with the slightly more expensive firm whose contact person was relaxed, helpful and friendly.The installation was satisfactory and the system seems to be running well.As it turned out the installation was not fully completed, partly due to a misunderstanding on my part.  When we got through the misunderstandings I admitted this and left the door open, as it were, for them to negotiate a resolution, but until the issue was taken up by Solar Quotes the matter remained unresolved.Solar quotes put me in touch with the owner who promptly arranged for the completion.  All is well now but I would not recommend this company in its present structure.

Hi whilst my solar has not yet been installed I am very happy with the service so far.Happy friendly easy to speak too very organized. It has been a very easy process so far.Thanks you for your help in finding the right company for meRegards Anne.
Very professional, came when they said they would & happy to answer questions. Would recommend . Well done
Smooth process from the initial visit until the installation of solar.Price was competitive

From the outset Solar 1 were very helpful and professional - even though we are experiencing Covid-19 restrictions their rep visited us at home with the correct distancing and mask protocols beingfollowed.Whenever we had contact by phone or email the arranged times were always met.Installation was performed as planned and the guys were courteous and knew their stuff.Grid connection is in process at the moment and all is progressing well.We're happy with the whole involvement with Solar 1 and highly recommend them!

The quoting process was really easy. Happy to beat the price from their competitors. Installation was slightly delayed due to staffing issue which was beyond their control. The installation was done smoothly without issues. Overall very happy with the chosen panels and inverter, and I have no problem recommending this company.
Sales was helpful without being pushy.Installation seamless.Price reasonable.
Very professional, prompt and tidy. Still waiting to be shown how to monitor the system on my phone
Smooth and easy quotation process.Timely reply and guidance through rebate applications.Regular phone contact and customer service supports.

All other suppiiers would only speak over phone or email.The Installation team (Steve and his mate) where fantastic very punctual, friendly and polite, the installation is very neat and tidy.Very happy with final result.Would Highly recommend "Solar 1 Electrical"

Very good service. Company rep came to check things out and discuss it all. Very smooth installation process. Left us with clear instructions re setting up app. Several things were discussed and questions answered. Company were prompt in attention to these
Not installed as yet, waiting for reply to my email earlier this week to know if they are still operating.
